style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, a heavy painted gouache background with deep inky blacks and one coloured light source (lantern orange or ghostly green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, anything monstrous drawn with grotesque detail and glowing eyes, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text, no lettering except where stated.

pictures.fw_burning: A farm cart cresting a ridge over dead fields lined with ragged scarecrows, an orange glow of a burning town on the horizon, a low orange moon
pictures.fw_burning_2: A windmill on a bluff turned into a spinning wheel of fire above a town square, figures in hats and bonnets brawling in the firelight below
pictures.fw_mill_falls: Burning windmill sails tearing loose and falling in a shower of sparks, the tower leaning in the night
pictures.fw_mill_falls_2: The windmill tower folding into itself in a column of orange sparks, tiny silhouettes running from it
pictures.fw_isaac_chest: A cellar chest with a carved-open ribcage inside it, black crows bursting out of it in a cloud
pictures.fw_isaac_chest_2: Crows knotting together in a stone cellar into the shape of a crow-headed demon, amber eyes glowing
pictures.fw_gate: A wall of impossibly tall corn at night swaying without wind, an orange moon behind it
pictures.fw_gate_2: Two great orange eyes with four-pointed star pupils opening between the corn stalks
pictures.fw_into_the_fields: Corn stalks parting and rising like redwoods around a lone path, an enormous harvest moon overhead
pictures.fw_into_the_fields_2: An orange harvest moon filling half the sky with cloud tendrils writhing out of it over an endless field
pictures.fw_virgil_comes: A humble straw-hatted scarecrow with a rusty birdcage in its chest, shaking in a crop circle at night
pictures.fw_virgil_comes_2: A demon erupting from a scarecrow: four black wings, a crow skull, a scythe raised to a harvest moon
pictures.fw_farewell: A faint scarecrow ghost with a banjo tipping his hat in a field at dawn
pictures.fw_farewell_2: The harvest moon turning from orange to white as the corn sinks to normal height around a silver ghost
pictures.fw_coming_home: Silver spirits drifting over fields toward a quiet farm town at dawn
pictures.fw_coming_home_2: On a porch a pumpkin head softening into a sleeping person, beside it a burned scarecrow that stays straw
pictures.fw_adela_paintings: A painting of a corn maze under an orange moon propped on an easel in a lamp-lit room
pictures.fw_adela_paintings_2: A painting of bats flying over mountains beneath a blood-red moon, the paint still wet
